facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act of 2021 also applies to aspects of AI use, particularly the processing of personal data.

ZWE.note: The charter, approved by Cabinet on 17 November 2026, sets ethical principles and a complaints procedure but its legal effect and any named authority are not stated.
No government body's use of an AI system is stated.
AI in farming, health, mining and education is a 2030 goal only; no tool is stated.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that Zimbabwe's Cabinet approved the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy for 2026-2030 in October 2025, and it was officially launched in March 2026.

ZWE.note: The AI/ML SandboxHub and a planned National AI and Data Platform are named, but no model, dataset or AI computing is stated as built or in service.
Nothing on the central bank's payments role.
Nothing on digital finance consumer protection.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency refers to Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act of 2021 as existing legislation that applies to the processing of personal data in AI use.

ZWE.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
Nothing on mobile money or retail payments.
A National AI Innovation Fund is only called for in the AI strategy; no startup law, labelling or fund is stated.
